capabilities: Extract external URLs from the active note, including kanban cards
Display the URL list in a pane with options for deduplication, aliases, favicons, and indicator icons
Navigate to a URL's location in the note or open it in a browser tab
Copy URLs or run a global search from the pane via right-click
Lock the URL list so it persists when switching notes
extras: Favicon and title metadata come from the free MicroLink API, limited to 50 requests/day, with memory or disk caching; the README lists a Todos section (URL favorites, footlinks, other views) indicating ongoing work.
intentEvidence: Thanks to the following great plugins for reference and inspiration
problem: Obsidian has no pane that collects the external URLs in a note, so reviewing or reopening links means scanning the note text manually.
